name: Browser Extensions

evidence.rationale: ATT&CK mentions ensuring operating systems and software are using the most current version.

Automated browser updates can remove deprecated extension-loading mechanisms and strengthen extension permission and installation controls. Extension allowlisting and trusted-source restrictions remain necessary to prevent malicious extensions.

Current browsers incorporate newer extension permission models, security controls, and protections against outdated installation methods. This does not prevent users or adversaries from installing an otherwise permitted malicious extension.

Browser extension allowlists, denylists, installation restrictions, and removal of unauthorized extensions directly prevent malicious browser extensions from establishing persistence or abusing inherited browser permissions.
